claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Benzylpenicillin is a bacterial cell wall synthesis inhibitor with no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent killing would reflect nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared mammalian mechanism.
